checks: The exact integer slices of the lifted hull follow from midpoint compatibility. The free base tilt gives thresholds s+t and s−t; compactness and saturated tails ensure finite attainment, and pure-base caps have the two stated original masses.

The accepted endpoint quantile inverse gives a continuous nonincreasing P with correct full and zero plateaus. Its finite full plateau threshold lies above the minimum support of the endpoint midpoint, and its empty threshold is that midpoint's upper support. Compatibility locates both within the middle support.

The middle F is continuous and strictly decreasing on its support interval by positive slab volume and null hyperplane boundaries. This gives unique s_B for each interior budget and the stated condition on g.

At full allocated mass the constraint imposes no lower threshold, so the negative infinity convention is correct. Every feasible allocation yields G≤B beyond its maximum, and the actual split F(s_B),P(s_B) attains exactly s_B, including a saturated paired split.

When B<min(b,m), the middle threshold increases and the endpoint threshold decreases continuously as p increases. This yields the crossing or correct endpoint of the maximum. The original §§1–2, (1)–(3), give all these cases.
